download_file_from_url: download a file from a URL to a local directory with retry logic and progress bar
download_from_google_drive: download a file from Google Drive using its file ID to a destination path
download_models_from_zoo: download pretrained models from the ParlAI model zoo into the data models directory
download_multiprocess_items: download multiple items in parallel using a process pool with chunked batch processing
extract_archive_file: extract a tar, tgz, or zip archive file to its containing directory and optionally delete it
